item.title: Authorities Investigate Suspected Human Remains Found in Cathedral City
item.description: Suspected human remains were found Tuesday in Cathedral City. The remains were found near Date Palm Drive and the eastbound Interstate 10 on-ramp, according to the Cathedral City Police Department. The on-ramp was closed while police investigated the discovery. No further information was immediately available.
